# Kakarot Extension - Instructions (v4)

## Project Overview

This repository contains the source code for the Paperback iOS app extensions for manga/comic sources. Each source lives in `src/<SourceName>/` with bundled output in `bundles/<SourceName>/`. **Edit only Hitomi and NHentai.**

## Architecture Pattern

Each extension follows a consistent multi-file structure:

```
src/<SourceName>/
├── main.ts         # Extension class implementing provider interfaces
├── pbconfig.ts     # Source metadata (name, version, capabilities)
├── settings.ts     # State management, constants, getter/setter pairs
├── forms.ts        # Settings UI using Form classes with Rows/Sections
├── interceptors.ts # Request/response interceptors for headers/auth
├── model.ts        # TypeScript interfaces for source-specific data
├── statistics.ts   # Statistics forms (ContentStatsForm, ScreenTimeForm)
├── common.ts       # Shared utilities (HitomiError, getIdSet, etc.)
├── constant.ts     # Static constants (domains, keys)
├── utils/          # Source-specific helpers
│   ├── gallery.ts  # Gallery fetching logic
│   ├── btree.ts    # B-tree gallery index search (Hitomi only)
│   └── uri.ts      # Image URI resolution (Hitomi only)
└── static/         # Icons and assets
```

### Form UI Construction

Forms use declarative builders with `Application.Selector` for callbacks:

```typescript
Section("sectionId", [
  SelectRow("fieldId", {
    title: "Label",
    value: [this.currentValue],
    options: OPTIONS.map((o) => ({ id: o.id, title: o.label })),
    onValueChange: Application.Selector(this as MyForm, "updateMethod"),
  }),
]);
```

Call `this.reloadForm()` after state changes to refresh UI.

## Developer Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Live reload server on port 3002
npm run bundle       # Build all extensions to bundles/
npm run test         # TypeScript check + lint + format + bundle
npm run lint         # ESLint with auto-fix
npm run format       # Prettier formatting
```

## Runtime Safety Warning

- Paperback's JavaScriptCore runtime does **not** provide reliable direct `setTimeout` / `clearTimeout` globals inside extension logic.
- Do not add new runtime dependencies on those APIs in `Hitomi` or `NHentai`.
- Use `Application.sleep(...)`, promise/microtask scheduling, or other Paperback-safe patterns instead.

---

## Critical: Two Separate Filter Systems

**This is the #1 source of bugs. These are completely separate:**

### 1. Search Filters (SearchFiltersForm in forms.ts)

- **Accessed via:** Search icon in app UI
- **Purpose:** One-time query filters
- **Persistence:** `SEARCH_FILTER_*_KEY` state keys
- **Hitomi includes:** Length, Date (daysOld), Tags
- **NHentai includes:** Length, Favorites, Date (daysOld), Tags

### 2. Manga Filters / Source Settings (MangaFiltersForm in forms.ts)

- **Accessed via:** Source Settings → "Manga Filters" navigation row
- **Purpose:** Persistent default filters applied to ALL searches
- **Persistence:** `INCLUDE_TAGS_STATE_KEY`, `EXCLUDE_TAGS_STATE_KEY`, `PAGES_EXPR_STATE_KEY`, `DAYS_OLD_FILTER_KEY`, etc.
- **Both sources include:** Include Tags, Exclude Tags, Page Count, Date Added, Favorites (NHentai only), Incognito Mode, Hide Read, Related settings

**Fallback behavior:** When Search Filters are set to "all", the extension should use Manga Filters settings instead.

## Hitomi Extension Details

### URL Rules - CRITICAL DISTINCTION

#### Nozomi URLs (Binary Gallery ID Fetching)

**Domain:** `ltn.gold-usergeneratedcontent.net`

**Format:** `https://ltn.gold-usergeneratedcontent.net/{prefix}{path}-{language}.nozomi`

| Type          | URL Pattern                                             |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Index (all)   | `/index-{language}.nozomi`                              |
| Female tag    | `/n/tag/female:{tag_name}-{language}.nozomi`            |
| Male tag      | `/n/tag/male:{tag_name}-{language}.nozomi`              |
| Neutral tag   | `/n/tag/{tag_name}-{language}.nozomi`                   |
| Popular sorts | `/popular/{today\|week\|month\|year}-{language}.nozomi` |

**Encoding Rules:**

- Spaces MUST be `%20` (URL encoded)
- NEVER use underscores in nozomi URLs
- `/n/` prefix required for search queries with tags
- Language suffix: `-all`, `-english`, `-japanese`, etc.

#### B-tree Gallery Index (Fuzzy Text Search)

Hitomi's fuzzy search uses a **B-tree index** hosted on the server, NOT search.html URLs.

**Protocol:**

1. Fetch index version from `{RESOURCE_DOMAIN}/galleriesindex/version`
2. SHA-256 hash the search term → first 4 bytes = B-tree key
3. Walk the B-tree at `galleriesindex/galleries.{version}.index` using HTTP Range requests (464-byte nodes)
4. When key found, get `(offset, length)` into the data file
5. Fetch gallery IDs from `galleriesindex/galleries.{version}.data` via Range request
6. Parse gallery IDs as big-endian Int32 values

**Implementation:** `utils/btree.ts` → `searchGalleryIdsByTerm()`

**CRITICAL Runtime Note:** Paperback uses JavaScriptCore (NOT Node.js/browser). Web APIs like `TextDecoder` are NOT available. Use `String.fromCharCode` loops or `Application.arrayBufferToUTF8String()` for buffer-to-string conversion.

### Fuzzy Search Implementation

Fuzzy search uses the B-tree index for partial term matching (e.g., "yu" matches "yuri"). Falls back to nozomi expansion (fetching `female:`, `male:`, and neutral nozomi files) when B-tree returns empty or fails.

**Settings and prefixes:**

| Setting / Prefix                                             | Behavior                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| "Always Force Fuzzy Search" ON                               | All tags use B-tree fuzzy search. Prefix `uf!` forces precise/nozomi search for specific tags. |
| "Always Force Fuzzy Search" OFF                              | All tags use precise nozomi search. Prefix `f!` forces B-tree fuzzy for specific tags.         |
| "Fuzzy Search Unknown Tags" ON (only visible when fuzzy OFF) | Tags not found in `tagTypeCache` automatically get fuzzy-searched via B-tree.                  |

**Search flow per tag:**

| Tag State                                     | Search Method                                        |
| --------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| Non-fuzzy, known type (`male`/`female`/`tag`) | Single nozomi fetch for that type                    |
| Non-fuzzy, `ambiguous` type                   | Fetch `female:`, `male:`, and neutral nozomi → union |
| Fuzzy (`f!` prefix or global fuzzy ON)        | B-tree search → if empty, nozomi expansion fallback  |
| `uf!` prefix (when global fuzzy ON)           | Forces precise nozomi search, skips B-tree           |

**OR group handling:** Tags separated by `||` or `OR` share an `orGroup` number. Same-group sets are unioned, then all groups are intersected (AND logic). The `orGroup` must be propagated through both fuzzy and non-fuzzy code paths in `gallery.ts`.

**Range response guard:** The fetcher in `main.ts` rejects Range responses > 2MB, but ONLY for `.index` URLs. B-tree `.data` file responses can legitimately be several MB for common terms (e.g., "a" → millions of IDs).

**Key files:** `utils/btree.ts` → `searchGalleryIdsByTerm()`, `gallery.ts` → `getGalleryIds()`, `main.ts` → `parseSingleTag()`, `getSearchResults()`

### Tag Type System

```typescript
type HitomiTagType =
  | "tag"
  | "male"
  | "female"
  | "artist"
  | "group"
  | "series"
  | "character"
  | "language"
  | "type"
  | "ambiguous";
```

- `ambiguous`: Tag exists as both `male:` and `female:` → fetch both and union
- Tag cache built from `alltags-{a-z,123}.html` pages
- `tagTypeCache` maps normalized slugs to types for query parsing

### Tag Cache System

Tags are fetched from `hitomi.la/alltags-{char}.html` pages (a-z plus "123") and cached with per-character timestamps.

**Key behavior:**

- **TTL:** 1 day per character (`TAG_CACHE_TTL_MS`)
- **Incremental refresh:** Only expired characters are re-fetched, not the entire cache
- **Batch size:** 5 concurrent fetches per batch
- **Retry:** One retry pass for failed characters
- **Validation:** `fetchCharPage` returns `false` if no tags were parsed (e.g., CloudFlare challenge page), preventing the character from being incorrectly marked as cached
- **Persistence:** Tags stored in `hitomi.tagCache`, per-char timestamps in `hitomi.tagCacheCharTimestamps`
- **Merged tags:** Slugs that exist as both `male:` and `female:` tracked in `hitomi.mergedMaleFemaleTagSlugs`

### Image URI Resolution (`utils/uri.ts`)

**GG.js synchronization:**

- Fetched from `https://ltn.gold-usergeneratedcontent.net/gg.js`
- Contains base path (`b`) and case numbers for subdomain calculation
- TTL: 30 minutes (`GG_CACHE_TTL_MS`)
- **Critical:** Must sync before generating image URLs

**Subdomain calculation:**

- Thumbnails: `{a,b}tn.gold-usergeneratedcontent.net`
- Full images: `{a,b}{1,2}.gold-usergeneratedcontent.net`
- Determined by hash code modulo operations from gg.js

### Caching Layers

1. **`idSetCache`**: Maps query keys to gallery ID arrays (2 min TTL)
2. **`nozomiUrlCache`**: Maps nozomi URLs to binary responses (2 min TTL)
3. **`nozomiUrlPending`**: Deduplicates in-flight nozomi fetches
4. **`nozomi404s`**: Session blacklist for 404 URLs
5. **`galleryCache`**: Gallery object cache (300 item limit)
6. **`coverCache`**: Cover URL cache (500 item limit)

### Read Tracking

```typescript
class ReadHistory {
  has(id: string): boolean; // O(1) lookup
  markRead(id: string): boolean; // Returns true if first read
  ordered: string[]; // Newest first, for Last Read section
}
```

- Persisted to `hitomi.readHistory`
- Migration from legacy keys on first load
- "Pause Manga Tracking" (incognito mode) stops new marks

### Related Section Pool

- Lazy-loaded in batches of `LAZY_BATCH_SIZE` history items (Hitomi: 6, NHentai: 4)
- Pattern: `[r1] [1] [2] [3] [4] [5] [r2] [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]...`
- Cross-session persistence via state keys
- Carousel target is always 6 tiles when enough data exists.
- Carousel consumes the related pool sequentially: start with `r1`, fill from its related entries, then spill into `r2`, `r3`, etc. without restarting or reshuffling on expansion.
- Related cycles now age out only after the user has scrolled **72 tiles past the final item of that `rN` cycle**.
- Persistent view counts (`incrementRelatedViewCount`) remain as telemetry only; cycle aging is now based on pool position rather than first-seen page tracking.
- `RELATED_PER_HISTORY = 8` related items per history manga

## NHentai Extension Details

### API Endpoints

| Purpose           | URL                                                                              |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Search            | `https://nhentai.net/api/galleries/search?query={query}&page={page}&sort={sort}` |
| Gallery           | `https://nhentai.net/api/gallery/{id}`                                           |
| Related (scraped) | `https://nhentai.net/g/{id}/`                                                    |

### Search Query Format

- Tag slugs use hyphens: `sole-female`, `big-breasts`
- Multi-word tags quoted: `"big breasts"` → `big-breasts` in slug
- Exclusion: `-tag:slug` or `-slug`
- Native NHentai filters: `uploaded:>30d`, `favorites:>10000`, `pages:<=30`

### OR Group Expansion

`getIncludeOrGroups()` extracts OR groups, `fetchSearchWithOrExpansion()` uses **union-then-intersect**:

1. For each OR group, fetch each alternative independently and union results within the group (via `fetchOrGroupUnion()`)
2. Intersect across all OR groups (galleries must appear in every group's union)
3. Sort merged results by `upload_date` descending (date sort) or return as-is (popularity sorts)
4. Fetches in batches of `DISCOVER_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE = 1` per group to stay within NHentai rate limits

**Complexity:** N × M requests (N = number of groups, M = avg alternatives per group) instead of M^N (cartesian product)

**Critical:** NHentai's API has zero native `OR` support. Never send a literal `OR` token or `||` operator in any request query. OR behavior must stay client-side by issuing separate requests per alternative and merging results locally.

### Date Filter Encoding

**Correct encoding:**

- `7` or `7d` → `7-` (newer than 7 days) → `uploaded:<7d` → `uploaded%3A%3C7d`
- `30+` → older than 30 days → `uploaded:>30d`

**Caution:** Ensure `<` encodes to `%3C` (not `%3E`). Wrong encoding causes 429/Cloudflare errors.

### Favorites Filter Performance Issue

When favorites threshold is high (e.g., `>50000`):

- API returns sparse results
- Extension makes many pagination requests
- Even with "Hide Read" disabled, result density is low
- **Root cause:** API-side filtering, not client-side

### Image URL Building

```typescript
// Thumbnails
`https://t${(media_id % 4) + 1}.nhentai.net/galleries/${media_id}/thumb.webp` // Covers
`https://t${(media_id % 4) + 1}.nhentai.net/galleries/${media_id}/cover.webp` // Full pages
`https://i${(media_id % 4) + 1}.nhentai.net/galleries/${media_id}/${index}.${ext}`;
```

Extension types: `j`→`jpg`, `p`→`png`, `g`→`gif`, `w`→`webp`

**GIF handling:** Both Hitomi and NHentai preserve original `.gif` extension. Do NOT convert gif to jpg — CDNs don't serve jpg alternatives for gif content.

### NHentai API Rate Limits (from nhentai.net/api/v2/docs)

**CRITICAL:** These rate limits are PER IP ADDRESS per minute. Burst-based rate limiting is used (not spacing-based).

| Endpoint                         | Rate Limit | Classification | Notes                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/api/v2/search`                 | 30/min     | search         | Most restrictive; returns `num_pages` but NOT `num_favorites` or `upload_date`                  |
| `/api/v2/galleries/{id}`         | 45/min     | galleryDetail  | Gallery detail endpoint (full data); slightly faster than search but more restrictive than list |
| `/api/v2/galleries` (list)       | 60/min     | galleries      | List endpoint; default 25 items per page, configurable 1-100 via `per_page` parameter           |
| `/api/v2/galleries/popular`      | 60/min     | galleries      | Popular galleries endpoint                                                                      |
| `/api/v2/galleries/{id}/related` | 90/min     | related        | Related galleries for a specific manga                                                          |
| `/api/v2/galleries/tagged`       | 90/min     | tagged         | Tagged search endpoint                                                                          |

**Burst-Based Rate Limiting Strategy (v5+):**

- Requests fire immediately if under the per-minute limit
- Only when the limit is reached does the system wait for the oldest request to expire from the 60s window
- This allows rapid loading (~8s target) when requests are under the limit
- Endpoint classes are tracked separately (search, galleryDetail, galleries, related, tagged)
- Prevents unnecessary delays while respecting hard rate limits

**Early Return on Rate Limit Hits:**

- If `hydrateLiteGalleries()` encounters 3+ consecutive 429 errors with no successful fetches, it returns early
- Returns partial results rather than retrying indefinitely
- Graceful degradation when rate limits are actually hit

### NHentai Data Retrieval Optimization (v4+)

**Search API Limitation:**

- Search returns `num_pages`, `id`, `thumbnail`, etc., but NOT `num_favorites` or `upload_date`
- To get favorites/upload_date requires calling `/api/v2/galleries/{id}` per item (45/min endpoint)
- This is why hydration exists—but it's only done when the user enables favorites/date display

**Hydration Conditional Logic:**

- **Hydration is SKIPPED** when: `show_favorite_count` is OFF AND `subtitle_date`/`subtitle_relative` are OFF
- **Hydration is REQUIRED** when: any of those three options are enabled
- Default: all three OFF (best performance: no hydration needed)
- When OFF: effective rate limit is 60/min (search endpoint)
- When ON: effective rate limit drops to 45/min (gallery detail endpoint)

**User-Facing Rate Limit Warning:**

- Settings footer displays current rate limit (45 or 60/min) based on display options
- When all options OFF: "API Rate Limit: 60 requests/minute (optimal speed). Enabling any Display Options below (Favorites in Subtitle, Date in Subtitle, or Relative Date in Subtitle) will reduce the limit to 45/minute."
- When options enabled: Shows which options are enabled with proper grammar (x, y, and z), reminds user they are in Display Options, and suggests which to disable
- Example footer: "API Rate Limit: 45 requests/minute (limited by Display Options). You have enabled: Favorites in Subtitle and Date in Subtitle. Disable these options in Display Options to increase rate limit to 60/minute for faster loading."
- Footer updates dynamically as user changes display settings

### NHentai Special Section Carousel Tiles (v5+)

Special sections (`related`, `top_reread`, `last_read`) show reduced tiles in carousel view:

| Section          | Carousel Tiles | Full View Tiles | Reason                                                                       |
| ---------------- | -------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Related          | 4              | 12              | Fetched via 90/min endpoint; carousel shows first 4 to minimize initial load |
| Top Reread       | 4              | 12              | Requires full hydration; carousel shows summary                              |
| Last Read        | 4              | 10              | Requires full hydration per item; carousel shows recent only                 |
| Popular sections | 6              | 12              | Standard sections use normal paging                                          |

## Statistics System (Both Sources)

### Form Hierarchy

```
StatisticsForm (main)
├── Overview section (counts, streaks, data received)
├── Streak grace section (Save Streak button, max 2 days)
├── ContentStatsForm (navigation)
│   ├── Page distribution
│   ├── Top tags (with Show More/Less)
│   └── Top rereads (with Show More/Less)
├── ScreenTimeForm (navigation)
│   ├── Week/Day toggle
│   ├── Bar charts
│   └── Week navigation (Previous/Next in daily view)
├── Contact section (with footer)
├── RemoveSpecificStatsForm (navigation)
│   ├── Multiselect categories
│   └── Confirm button
└── Reset All Statistics button
```

### State Keys

| Data              | Hitomi                            | NHentai                            |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Install date      | `hitomi.stats.installDate`        | `nhentai.stats.installDate`        |
| Displayed count   | `hitomi.stats.displayedManga`     | `nhentai.stats.displayedManga`     |
| Distinct count    | `hitomi.stats.displayedDistinct`  | `nhentai.stats.displayedDistinct`  |
| Sessions          | `hitomi.stats.sessions`           | `nhentai.stats.sessions`           |
| Page counts       | `hitomi.stats.pageCounts`         | `nhentai.stats.pageCounts`         |
| Tag counts        | `hitomi.stats.tagCounts`          | `nhentai.stats.tagCounts`          |
| Read count map    | `hitomi.stats.readCounts`         | `nhentai.stats.readCounts`         |
| Screen time       | `hitomi.stats.screenTime`         | `nhentai.stats.screenTime`         |
| Screen time mode  | `hitomi.stats.screenTimeMode`     | `nhentai.stats.screenTimeMode`     |
| Tag display limit | `hitomi.stats.tagDisplayLimit`    | `nhentai.stats.tagDisplayLimit`    |
| Reread limit      | `hitomi.stats.rereadDisplayLimit` | `nhentai.stats.rereadDisplayLimit` |
| Streak grace      | `hitomi.stats.streakGrace`        | `nhentai.stats.streakGrace`        |

### Display Limit Steps

- **Tags:** `[75, 50, 25, 15, 10, 5, 3, 1]` — default 75
- **Rereads:** `[75, 50, 25, 15, 10, 5, 3, 1]` — default 10

### Selective Stats Reset

`STAT_CATEGORIES` array defines resetable groups:

- Displayed Manga Counts, Read Count & Rereads, Reading Sessions & Streak
- Page Count Distribution, Tag Counts, Screen Time, Data Received

`resetSpecificStats(categoryIds)` clears only selected groups.

### Streak Grace System

- `getStreakGraceDays()` / `setStreakGraceDays()` — 0-2 days
- Grace allows N consecutive missed days without breaking current/longest streak
- "Save Streak" button in StatisticsForm adds +1 day (max 2)
- Both current streak and longest streak calculations use grace tolerance

### Reread Cooldown

- `recordMangaReadCount()` enforces a **5-minute cooldown** per manga for rereads
- First reads (`isFirstRead = true`) bypass the cooldown
- In-memory `rereadTimestamps` Map tracks last read time per manga ID
- Auto-prunes entries older than 5 minutes when map exceeds 500 entries
- Prevents inflated reread counts from rapid manga re-opening

### Screen Time & Date Handling

- **All date keys must use local dates**, not UTC. Using `toISOString().slice(0,10)` causes off-by-one day errors near midnight.
- Correct pattern: build `YYYY-MM-DD` from `getFullYear()`, `getMonth()+1`, `getDate()`
- When parsing stored date keys back to Date objects, use `new Date(year, month-1, day)` (local) instead of `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` (parsed as UTC)
- Screen time daily labels use format: `Sun of 2.20.26` (3-letter weekday + "of" + M.DD.YY)

### Default Search Sort

- `getDefaultSearchSortSetting()` validates the stored sort value against the current visible discover section order
- If the stored sort is hidden or doesn't match any visible section, falls back to the **first visible discover section's** sort ID
- Hitomi: discover section IDs map directly to sort IDs
- NHentai: uses `DISCOVER_TO_SORT_MAP` to translate (e.g., `"new_uploads"` → `"date"`)

### Tag Distribution in Description

- Tags are split between the description (promoted) and scroller sections
- Formula: roughly half in description, capped at 15
  - `totalTags >= 10`: `min(15, floor(totalTags / 2))`
  - `totalTags >= 5`: `floor(totalTags / 2)`
  - `totalTags < 5`: `ceil(totalTags / 2)`
- Scroller always gets the remaining tags

### Discover Section Loading

**Hitomi — Incremental Gallery Loading:**

- Gallery IDs are fetched/cached from nozomi files or B-tree, then resolved incrementally via `getGalleryDetailsIncremental()`
- Processes IDs in batches of `INCREMENTAL_BATCH = 12` parallel `loadGallery()` calls
- Stops as soon as `targetCount` (default `CAROUSEL_PAGE_SIZE = 10`) items pass page/date/read filters
- Much more efficient than the old "fetch 30, resolve all, slice to 10" pattern — especially for heavy readers
- `MIN_CAROUSEL_TILES = 6`: minimum items before reporting a page; if fewer IDs remain, returns what it has

**NHentai — Sequential Page Scanning:**

- Each discover section scans API pages sequentially in a single `getDiscoverSectionItems()` call
- `MAX_PAGES = 10` per section (15 for `popular_all` and `popular_month` which have more read items to skip)
- No manual pauses between pages — rate limiter handles pacing (8 req/s)
- Returns `metadata: undefined` when no items found (framework won't retry sections that return metadata with empty items)
- `MIN_CAROUSEL_TILES = 3`: minimum items before reporting a page

**Section ordering:** Both sources place their slowest popular section **last** in `ALL_DISCOVER_SECTIONS` (`popular_year` for Hitomi, `popular_all` for NHentai) so other sections load first.

| Source  | MIN_CAROUSEL_TILES | CAROUSEL_PAGE_SIZE / limit                     |
| ------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Hitomi  | 6                  | 10 standard, 6 for random/last_read/top_reread |
| NHentai | 3                  | 4 carousel for special sections, 12 standard   |

### Display Option Labels

- "Show Tag Counts in Search" (was: "Show Tag Counts in Search Filter's Tag List")
- "Show Tag Count Abbreviations (11k)" (Hitomi only; was: "Abbreviate Tag Counts (147k)")

### Filter Tag Sync

When manga filter include/exclude tags change via `setIncludeTagsSetting()` or `setExcludeTagsSetting()`, `syncMangaFilterTagsToSearchFilterTags()` automatically updates `SEARCH_FILTER_TAGS_KEY` to match.

### Section Footer Convention

Tips and informational text use `Section({ id, footer })` instead of standalone LabelRows. Footer text uses **Title Case Capitalization** (e.g., "Search Filters Save On App Restart.").

### Search Filter "Apply Manga Filter Tags"

Both sources include an `applyMangaTags` dropdown in `getSearchFilters()` with options: Off / Include Tags Only / Include & Exclude Tags. When activated in `getSearchResults()`, manga filter include/exclude tags are merged into the search query for that particular search only — does not modify manga filter state.

### Convention Tag Filtering (Hitomi)

`UGLY_CONVENTION_TAG_PATTERN = /^(sc|csp|cr|ct|ac|c)\d+$/i` filters convention-specific tags (e.g., "c100", "sc2024", "ac3") from:

- Search filter tag list (`getSearchFilters` threshold: `count >= 50`)
- Description promoted tags (`buildSynopsis`)
- Tag scroller sections (`convertTags`)

### Related Section Page-0 Aging Exemption

Items first seen on page 0 (`firstPage === 0`) are exempt from session-based aging in `filterPool()`. This ensures the initial batch of related items is never aged out, only items seen on subsequent pages get filtered after `RELATED_VIEW_THRESHOLD` (6) pages.

### NHentai Related Language Expansion

When `relatedLang !== "all"`, the related section loads additional pool items in up to 3 expansion attempts to compensate for language-filtered items, ensuring enough results are returned.

### DiscoverSectionDef

```typescript
interface DiscoverSectionDef {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string; // e.g., "Applies to Home and Search"
}
```

Subtitles shown on toggle rows in DiscoverOrderForm. Section order header shows current visible order.

## Common Pitfalls & Debugging

### Hitomi

| Symptom                        | Likely Cause                                                                          |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Zero results with fuzzy search | Using nozomi encoding (spaces) instead of search.html encoding (underscores in slugs) |
| Duplicate nozomi requests      | Missing `/n/` prefix causing cache miss                                               |

### NHentai

| Symptom                 | Likely Cause                                        |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| JSON parse error on `<` | 429/Cloudflare response; check date filter encoding |
| Sparse search results   | High favorites threshold with API-side filtering    |
| Related section empty   | HTML scraping failed; check selector patterns       |

### Both

| Symptom                          | Likely Cause                                                                                          |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Settings not persisting          | Wrong state key prefix (`hitomi.` vs `nhentai.`)                                                      |
| Screen time dates off by 1       | Using UTC (`toISOString`) instead of local date for date keys                                         |
| Wrong default sort in search     | Stored sort not validated against visible discover section order                                      |
| Reread count inflated            | Missing 5-minute cooldown in `recordMangaReadCount()`                                                 |
| Related [rN] starts at wrong #   | Pool not re-indexed after filtering out excluded items                                                |
| Related shows old scrolled items | Session-based page aging not applied in `filterPool()`                                                |
| `maxItemCount` crash             | SelectRow with `maxItemCount: 0` — use `Math.max(1, length)`                                          |
| Discover section stuck loading   | Returning `metadata` with empty `items` — framework won't retry. Return `metadata: undefined` instead |
| Sections blocking each other     | Shared global backoff state (e.g., `rateLimitCooldownUntil`). Use per-request retries only            |

### NHentai Rate Limiting: Architectural Decisions (v4-v5)

**Problem Statement:**

- Initial implementation was hitting 429 rate limit errors constantly
- Load times for all 6 discover sections exceeded 100 seconds
- Root cause: Requesting full gallery details (via 45/min endpoint) for ALL results, even when not needed

**Solution: Conditional Hydration (v4)**

1. **Analyze what data is needed:** Search API provides `num_pages` (sufficient for basic subtitles)
2. **Make hydration conditional:** Only fetch full gallery data when user enables favorites/date display
3. **Track rate limits separately:** Use distinct queues for search (30/min), gallery detail (45/min), and galleries (60/min)
4. **Reduce tile counts:** 10→6 for carousel, 24→12 for standard sections

**Further Optimization: Burst-Based Rate Limiting (v5)**

1. **Replace spacing delays:** Instead of waiting 1-2s between requests, allow burst to rate limit
2. **Implement request counting:** Track timestamps in 60s window per endpoint class
3. **Add early return:** Stop retrying after 3 consecutive 429s when hydrating
4. **Reduce special sections:** Only show 4 tiles for related/reread/last-read in carousel

**Result:**

- Load times: 100+s → target ~8s (when under rate limits)
- API efficiency: Unnecessary 45/min calls eliminated by default
- User control: Settings footer explains the tradeoff between display options and rate limits

**Key Lesson:**
Rate limiting is not about slowing down requests uniformly—it's about understanding the different limits per endpoint and only hitting the slower ones when necessary.

## Performance Optimizations

### Hitomi

- **Incremental gallery loading** (`getGalleryDetailsIncremental`): Resolves gallery IDs in batches of 12 (`INCREMENTAL_BATCH`), stops as soon as enough items pass filters. Avoids wasted work when many items are filtered out (read/page-count/date).
- **Nozomi URL caching** (`nozomiUrlCache`): Binary nozomi responses are cached with 2-min TTL, preventing duplicate HTTP fetches across different discover sections that share tag URLs
- **In-flight deduplication** (`nozomiUrlPending`, `idSetPending`): Parallel sections awaiting the same nozomi URL share a single fetch via Promise dedup maps
- **404 blacklist** (`nozomi404s`): Failed nozomi URLs are blacklisted for the session to avoid repeated 404s (capped at 500)
- **Gallery cache** (`galleryCache`): LRU-style cache (300 items) avoids re-fetching gallery JSON for already-loaded items
- **Cover cache** (`coverCache`): Resolved cover image URLs cached (500 items) to avoid re-running gg.js subdomain calculation
- **Tag cache incremental refresh**: Only expired characters (1-day TTL) are re-fetched, not the entire A-Z + 123 set
- **Related pool lazy loading**: Pool grows in batches of `LAZY_BATCH_SIZE=6` history items as user scrolls, avoiding upfront cost
- **Section ordering**: `popular_year` placed last in `ALL_DISCOVER_SECTIONS` so lighter sections finish first

### NHentai

- **Sequential page scanning**: Discover sections scan API pages one at a time within a single call, up to `MAX_PAGES` (10, or 15 for `popular_all`)
- **Per-request retries** (no global backoff): `fetchJson` retries up to 3 times with short pauses (250ms×attempt for HTML responses, 150ms×attempt for errors). No shared `rateLimitCooldownUntil` — sections don't stall each other.
- **Rate limiter**: 8 requests/second (`bufferInterval: 1.0`, `ignoreImages: true`) — handles pacing so no manual pauses needed between discover pages
- **Gallery cache** (`galleryCache`): In-memory Map caches loaded gallery objects to avoid duplicate API calls
- **Related ID cache**: Scraped related IDs persisted with 24-hour TTL (state key: `nhentai.relatedIdsCache`), pruned to 500 entries
- **Sequential scraping**: Related manga scraping done sequentially (not parallel) to avoid triggering Cloudflare 429s
- **Related pool lazy loading**: Pool grows in batches of `LAZY_BATCH_SIZE=4` history items (smaller than Hitomi to avoid 429s)
- **Section ordering**: `popular_all` placed last in `ALL_DISCOVER_SECTIONS` since it's most likely to need deep scanning

### Both Sources

- **Reread timestamp map auto-prune**: In-memory `rereadTimestamps` map auto-prunes entries older than 5 minutes when size exceeds 500
- **Session-based related aging**: `relatedFirstSeenPage` uses O(1) Map lookups per item vs. the more expensive approach of incrementing all past items
- **Read history O(1) lookup**: `ReadHistory.has()` uses Set-based lookup for constant-time read checks
- **Parallel gallery loading** (NHentai only): Related section loads galleries in parallel via `Promise.all` before rendering
- **Framework caveat**: Returning `{ items: [], metadata: {...} }` from `getDiscoverSectionItems()` causes the section to get stuck in "loading" — framework does NOT auto-retry. Always return `metadata: undefined` when no items are found.
